wins.text: Record quarterly net inflows of $221 billion, representing 8% annualized organic asset growth — highest net flows quarter ever
Q3 revenue of $5.2 billion, up 15% YoY, and operating income of $2.1 billion, up 26% YoY — both record quarterly levels
Operating margin expanded 350 basis points YoY to 45.8%, driven by operating leverage and variabilization of expenses
iShares ETF net inflows of $97 billion in Q3 and $248 billion YTD; fixed income ETF AUM crossed $1 trillion milestone
Aladdin ACV grew 15% YoY, consistent with long-term low-to-mid-teens target, including a large U.S. asset manager selecting Aladdin as its unified investment management platform

risks.text: EPS of $11.46 grew only 5% YoY, significantly lagging 26% operating income growth, due to a 26% effective tax rate in Q3 2024 vs. a $215M discrete tax benefit in Q3 2023
Annualized effective fee rate declined approximately 0.4 bps sequentially due to relative outperformance of lower-fee U.S. equity markets and lower securities lending revenue
Integration execution risk from simultaneous GIP close (400 new employees, $116B AUM) and pending Preqin acquisition expected to close year-end 2024
GIP transaction required issuance of ~6.9 million shares of BlackRock common stock, with ~5 million additional shares deferred, creating dilution risk
Technology services revenue down 1% YoY due to prior-year eFront on-premises license renewal timing, creating a difficult comparable

guidance_items.detail: Organic base fee growth target of 5% reaffirmed as long-term goal; Q3 achieved 5% annualized organic base fee growth
GIP expected to contribute ~$250M in management fees in Q4 2024, with ~$1B in fees and FRE margin north of 50% modeled for 2025
Share repurchases of at least $375M anticipated in Q4, consistent with prior guidance
Headcount expected broadly flat in 2024 ex-GIP; full-year core G&A expense growth now expected closer to high end of low-to-mid-single-digit range inclusive of GIP
25% projected tax run rate for remainder of 2024; Preqin acquisition expected to close around year-end 2024

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Competitive RFP activity and market share opportunity stemming from regulatory issues at a large institutional bond manager (PIMCO implied)
Appetite and capacity for additional M&A given simultaneous GIP integration and pending Preqin close
Digital assets regulatory outlook and BlackRock's ambitions beyond ETFs under a potentially more crypto-friendly administration
